name: 2-Hour KLCC Chill Plan

steps.description: Walk through the park — head to the lake side for the best Petronas view with fewer people
steps.insider_tip: Enter from the Traders Hotel side, not the main Suria entrance — much quieter

steps.description: Cool off with a drink and a quick browse through the Japanese foodhall on the lower ground floor
steps.insider_tip: Skip the main mall food court — the Isetan basement has better coffee and quieter seating

steps.description: Walk back out to the park's south end at sunset — the towers light up around 7:15pm
steps.insider_tip: The fountain show runs every 15 minutes after dark — best photo angle is from the bench row near the playground

why_it_works: Minimal walking, weather-safe with indoor options, efficient use of time

name: 3-Hour Bukit Bintang Hidden Gems

steps.description: Underground heritage hawker hall — best of KL's old-school stalls under one roof
steps.insider_tip: Skip the queue at the front stall; the Hokkien mee at stall #23 is the original recipe — line moves fast

steps.description: Hidden alley with old-school chendol and tau fu fa stalls — locals only, no tour buses
steps.insider_tip: The third stall on the left does the best chendol — gula melaka is house-made daily

steps.description: Rooftop helipad-turned-bar with the best skyline view in KL — sunset slot is unbeatable
steps.insider_tip: Get there 30 min before sunset for a railing seat; drinks are pricey but the view is the show

why_it_works: Three locals-only spots in walking distance — food, sweets, sunset view — with an arc that builds to the rooftop finale
